written.headline: AI accelerates semiconductor fab simulations up to 35x
written.summary: AI is transforming semiconductor manufacturing by speeding up simulations and enabling digital twins, allowing engineers to evaluate more alternatives before physical trials. NVIDIA’s cuDSS and PhysicsNeMo libraries deliver up to 35× faster multiphysics simulations for Applied Materials and up to 17× acceleration for Siemens lithography software.

notes: dropped unverifiable benchmark: Siemens cuLitho with Calibre key lithography simulation acceleration up to 17x
